title: Native-only conversation history survives an offline browser restart
description: Run the Command Center native-store proof as an issued native-only person assigned one private execution node. Select that person profile through FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PROFILE and the fixture through FARMSLOT_NATIVE_STORE_PROOF. The native host serves one setup-time closed history through the actual node and gateway. This proves the native-only shell layout, 200 complete messages, one saved SQLite history, cold age and disabled Resume, current recovery and no command replay. The separate farm-role recipe proves ten-session eviction. Setup journals do not represent provider execution. Use only private roots, owned ports and the existing isolated CDP browser; evidence stays outside source.

proofTargets.claim: The actual native host supplies complete history to the real conversation view.
Opened histories retain the last 200 complete messages.
The native-only browser stores its opened history in SQLite.
A new offline document restores the opened conversation.
Cold restoration preserves the exact saved time and visible age.
The actual Resume action is disabled while saved data is stale.
Current reads restore history and Resume authority after gateway restart.
Clicking the stale action neither sends nor replays a command.
